findings.label: SOURCED_CURRENT_CHAIN_METRICS
findings.claim: DefiLlama's Nov 1 Arc page reports $591.42M TVL, $1.097B stablecoin cap (99% USDC), $12.8M DEX volume/24h and $90.96M perps volume/24h.

findings.label: INDEPENDENT_ONCHAIN_ANALYSIS
findings.claim: Bitquery's first-month Arc study reports 94% active-wallet decline, 38% of DEX volume from one self-trading wallet, 22% from a 117-wallet bot cluster, and $189.8M USDC borrowed against cirBTC at 97% utilization.
findings.caveat: Window ends Oct14; bot/farm filters are methodological proxies.

findings.label: CORRECTION
findings.claim: Circle's 98.8% USDC agent-driven transaction-volume figure is global Agent Stack/x402 activity, not Arc-chain-specific volume.

findings.label: CONFIRMED_CORPORATE_CAPITAL_LINKS
findings.claim: SBI Group reports approximately 9% Ripple equity; SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank invested $50M in Circle; SBI participated in Circle's ARC presale through a subsidiary, amount undisclosed.
findings.caveat: Equity investments are not direct XRP/USDC token holdings.

findings.label: CONFIRMED_MULTI_RAIL_OPERATIONS
findings.claim: SBI VC Trade distributes USDC in Japan and signed an MOU to issue/distribute RLUSD; SBI Remit has XRP remittance corridors; SBI Group is an Arc founding validator.
findings.caveat: RLUSD MOU is not proof of live distribution; current XRP corridor throughput unknown.

findings.label: CROSS_CHAIN_CREDIT_STRUCTURE
findings.claim: Morpho hosts USDC borrowing against cirBTC on Arc and cbXRP on Base; Circle-issued USDC is the shared debt asset, while collateral and markets are distinct.

unresolved: Arc stablecoin cap $1.097B on Nov1 versus Bitquery's $604M USDC mid-October observation requires same-methodology reconciliation.
SBI's specific ARC presale contribution, token allocation, lockup and delivery are undisclosed.
SBI RLUSD MOU status and live volumes are unknown.
AgentGDP's Arc x402 coverage is partial; it does not measure all Arc activity.
SBIC remains distinct from SBI Group; no direct XRP/Circle relationship established.
